detail.longDescription: I know the best approach to a calm, focused workday is to dive into my deepest work with as few distractions as possible. But we live on Slack at Zapier, so calm, focused, and distraction-free are hard to come by. Slack to-do lists give you a one-click way to corral chats into an organized to-do list without leaving the app. But beyond Slack's dedicated to-do list feature, here are a few other ways to create and manage a to-do list in Slack.
